episodes.title: The Futures of You & Me
episodes.summary: Webtoon producer Seo Mi-rae's ordinary life is disrupted by workplace stress & by the enchanting opportunity to test a new virtual dating service. !!

episodes.title: Cliche or Classic
episodes.summary: Mi-rae's first virtual date sweeps her off her feet & into a high-society fantasy; And helps to wage a war when she is pitted against Park Kyeong-nam ...

episodes.title: First Love 101
episodes.summary: Mi-rae's second date unfolds on a college campus, but her match plays hard to get while memories of her first love keep coming back.

episodes.title: No Risk, High Return
episodes.summary: After her free trial abruptly ends, Mi-rae pays the high price to make the most of virtual dating, an investment with sweet returns & zero risk.

episodes.title: The Caveats of Perfection
episodes.summary: Mi-rae reconnects with someone from her past & their date feels new.  A Naemo team workshop sparks an awkward confession.

episodes.title: The Hybrid Man
episodes.summary: Mi-rae's dream date with the next match leaves her unimpressed, but she returns to the service after hearing some sobering advice.

episodes.title: The Algorithm of Feelings
episodes.summary: While the virtual & real worlds begin to blend for Mi-rae; she is tasked to create a game plan for Yun Song, leading to a surprise group gathering.

episodes.title: The Odd or Even Game
episodes.summary: As a real-life connection challenges Mi-rae's devotion to virtual dating, her defenses begin to crumble & the fear of being alone resurfaces.

episodes.title: Like or Love
episodes.summary: After misunderstandings & mixed messages, Mi-rae turns to the virtual world for advice.  Can She find answers & a new way to open her heart ??

episodes.title: An Utterly Normal Future
episodes.summary: Series Finale- After misunderstandings & mixed messages, Mi-rae returns to the virtual world for advice.  Maybe She will find answers & new way to open her heart !!
